text:
#WATCH | A mysterious well in Virparda village of Morbi taluka, Gujarat, has once again shown unusual activity, with its water appearing to move on its own. The phenomenon resumed around 3:00 PM today after a similar disturbance, observed two days ago, had subsided earlier in the day. 

The unusual event has attracted large crowds of villagers eager to witness it. The exact cause remains unknown, though some residents speculate it could be linked to seismic activity, as the area lies in an earthquake-prone region of Gujarat.
